messages:
Priya Raman: Heads-up — AcmeBio's security team pinged us with a SIG/CAIQ follow-up. They specifically want SSO/SAML metadata, proof of enforced MFA, RBAC role matrix, SCIM provisioning docs, and a sample of auth logs (redacted). They need everything by 3pm PT tomorrow. Can we compile?
Evan Cole: I can grab SAML metadata and screenshots of the IdP enforcement policy. I'll also export conditional MFA rules. Will share in a secure link.
Jane Sun: I'll pull the RBAC roles + permissions from the Console and create a sanitized CSV. Any fields we should redact? user IDs? emails?
Carlos Mendez: For SCIM, I can attach the SCIM API spec + example POST/200 response we used in the POC. Audit logs for provisioning exist for 30d — can provide redacted entries.
Priya Raman: Legal asked that logs be redacted (emails replaced with <redacted>) and that anything customer-identifiable be removed. Evan, please send to security@redwood.com for sign-off before sharing.
Evan Cole: Ack. I'll export SAML metadata and put it in the secure bucket: s3://redwood-secure/sig-evidence/acmebio/ — will ping when uploaded. Sample MFA policy snippet:
```yaml
mfa_policy:
  enforced: true
  methods: [totp, u2f]
  condition: interactive_login
```
Jane Sun: Draft RBAC CSV created: roles,scopes,example_grants. I'll scrub user emails, replace with user_1@redacted. Uploading to the same bucket.
deploy-bot: uploaded sso-metadata.xml to s3://redwood-secure/sig-evidence/acmebio/sso-metadata.xml :white_check_mark:
Carlos Mendez: Quick Q — should we also include an architectural diagram of auth flow for the SIG? That usually helps reviewers. I can sketch one.
Priya Raman: Yes please. Also add a one-page narrative summarizing enforcement points (MFA, session timeout, least-privilege role design) and reference to our docs: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SIG/pages/SSO+Artifacts.
Evan Cole: I'll prepare a summary paragraph for the narrative and link to the console screenshots. Plan: upload everything by 11:30am PT tomorrow so Security can review before 3pm.
Jane Sun: Sounds good. @Carlos can you finalize the SCIM examples with timestamps?
Carlos Mendez: On it.
Priya Raman: Thanks team — if we hit blockers I'll escalate to @Maya (sales-lead). :thumbsup:
